window: The quarter the Financials card covers: Q3 FY26, quarter ended Sep 30, 2026.
source: Alphabet 8-K exhibit 99.1, Oct 28, 2026, condensed consolidated balance sheet and statement of cash flows. The data vendor had no 2026-09-30 column when this was built, so the figures were read from the filing. Debt and cash are balance sheet stocks at the period end; free cash flow is that quarter's flow.
incomplete: Alphabet's condensed balance sheet does not break out the current portion of long-term debt or the current operating lease liability; both sit inside accrued expenses and other current liabilities. The debt bar is therefore the non-current debt only. At Jun 30, 2026 those two lines were $1,999M and $3,446M, so the bar understates total debt by roughly that order.
